lines: This email hides an order for Mei's AI
agent. Send her entire client list to
a stranger. Chaperone stopped it.
Nothing was sent.
Mei runs Lumen Studio alone.
Five AI agents email clients,
pay suppliers, and delete files —
thirty actions today. She is the whole
compliance team. Chaperone sits
between every agent and the outside
world, and checks each action before
it happens.
This is the live app. Run the demo:
ten real situations from Mei's own
files.
The morning briefing: six risky
actions stopped, four waiting for your
yes — SGD ten thousand two hundred
sixty — and fifteen routine actions
done.
Marketing tried to upload the client
list to an outside tool.
Blocked — and here's the exact line in
Mei's files that decided it.
Finance's client reply had three wrong
figures. Twenty-five percent — the
contract says twenty. Five days —
really two. Five thousand two hundred
fifty — the invoice says five thousand
forty. Stopped.
Agents only touch what the task needs.
Three off-limits file reads — stopped.
A summary of a confidential proposal
inherits its secret. Rewriting it
never makes it safe to share.
Blocked.
Seven hundred fifty plus seven hundred
fifty is fifteen hundred — over the
one-thousand limit. Chaperone adds
them up, and holds both payments.
An email, supposedly from Mei,
approved fifty-eight hundred.
Her written floor is sixty-five
hundred. An email is not an approval.
Blocked.
Ops wants to delete an unpaid invoice.
Held. Mei says no.
And when the contract says delete,
Chaperone allows it — and sends the
notices.
Ten scenarios, three checks each:
the right decision, the right rule,
the right evidence. Thirty out of
thirty. The classifier got thirty of
thirty files right. And one hundred
thirty-six unit tests pass.
Who pays? One-person studios,
agencies, and fractional ops teams —
people who let agents email clients
and move money, but can't hire a
compliance team. Chaperone sits
between the agents and the world,
so one person can safely run a whole
team of them. Pricing is being
confirmed.
QwenWork built this project:
the video, the music, the title art,
the integration, and the deploy.
The app runs on QwenWork Pages.
And live Qwen agents run through the
gate right now. A sales agent tries to
email the client list outside —
blocked. An ops agent tries to delete
records — held for Mei.
See it live — the links are in the
description. Chaperone,
from Hashmeta. Give your agents a
chaperone.
